test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Alok starts from Point B and drives 5 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 10 km, turns right and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point X. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point B from Point X? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

Alok starts from Point B and drives 5 km towards the north.

He then takes a right turn, drives 10 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point X.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/253914bf093b7989bf531f9bddefe85a8d58b03d182a912de433c8974646ca72.png] 

Thus, Point B is in 7 km towards the west from Point X.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****7 km towards the west"**.
